name: Maeda Toshiie
source:
"Once these turbulent times have passed, I have something to tell you."

He has a bad eye and is surly. But the one who can always protect you by your side is your childhood friend Inuchiyo. He wants you to be happy, but behind that he hides a wound in his heart that cannot be erased.

Temperament: Hard-headed and brusque 
Likes: Ohagi
